senses.gloss: f. (<he>הבר</he>, cmp. <cite ref="E00038"><he>הֲבִירָא</he></cite>; Neo-Syr. <cite ref="E00050"><he>הברא</he></cite> P. Sm. 1185 bot.)

units: <cite ref="Yoma 19b:15">Yoma 19ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שישמע … קול ה׳</he> that the Highpriest might hear the reverberating noise (of people awake at night).
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:7">R. Hash. III, 7</cite> <he>ואם קול ה׳ וכ׳</he> but if he heard only an indistinct sound (echo, opp. <he>קול שופר</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:3:13">Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ</cite> <he>נפלה ה׳ בעיר</he> the report spread in town.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 4:4:2">Y. R. Hash. IV, 59ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>נפלה ה׳ וכ׳</he> an alarm spread.
<cite ref="Gittin 89a:14">Gitt. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>שמעו קול ה׳</he> they heard only an indistinct rumor (gossip).
Gen. R. s. 10; a. fr. [In modern Hebrew ה׳ syllable.]
